WITH sales AS (
  SELECT p.sku, SUM(f.net_amount) AS gross_web_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE f.channel_id IN (2, 3) AND f.sale_date >= DATE '2025-11-03'
  GROUP BY p.sku),
refunds AS (
  SELECT p.sku, SUM(r.refund_net) AS refunds_net
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE (f.channel_id IN (2, 3) OR f.channel_code = 'WB') AND r.return_date >= DATE '2025-11-03'
  GROUP BY p.sku)
SELECT s.sku, cur.product_name, cur.category,
       ROUND(s.gross_web_sales - COALESCE(r.refunds_net, 0), 2) AS web_net_sales_eur
FROM sales s
JOIN dim_product cur ON cur.sku = s.sku AND cur.is_current
LEFT JOIN refunds r ON r.sku = s.sku
ORDER BY web_net_sales_eur DESC
LIMIT 10
